# [TASK] Service Integration Testing

## Task
Cross-service integration tests: a gateway-boundary suite for routing, auth,
error propagation, circuit breaking and rate limiting, full-stack journeys
across movie, user and actor through the gateway, and a Postman/newman
acceptance gate against a running stack.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The gateway routes public and protected calls, propagates a downstream
      404 and 500, opens the circuit breaker onto the fallback and returns 429
      when the burst is spent, against WireMock downstreams and a Testcontainers
      Redis (`GatewayIntegrationTest`)
- [x] Full user journeys cross services through the gateway: favorites and
      watchlist round-trip, actor details with filmography, movies by actor,
      and an unauthenticated call rejected at the boundary (`FullStackJourneyIT`)
- [x] The Postman collection runs green against a live stack, including the
      health, Eureka-registry and OpenAPI checks
      (`infrastructure/docker/smoke-test.sh`, run nightly by
      `.github/workflows/e2e-smoke.yml`)
- [x] The strategy is written down: which layer tests what, and why the
      journeys are not one Testcontainers suite (no test: documentation,
      `docs/architecture/INTEGRATION_TESTING.md`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4-5

## Notes
`FullStackJourneyIT` skips itself when the gateway is not reachable, so
`./gradlew build` stays green on a machine with no stack running. The nightly
smoke workflow is what makes those journeys run unattended.

Test counts were removed from the criteria; the suites are named instead, so
adding a test no longer makes this issue wrong.

Coverage and response times stay per module: database-per-service (ADR-002)
leaves no single meaningful number. Load-test targets are #45.
